description: Search every live list on Curated, not just the person's own. Each result carries `access` (yours, unlocked or locked) and a `ref` of the form handle/slug, the unambiguous way to name a list in get_list.

category.description: Optional category slug to narrow results, e.g. "restaurants".

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "natural wine bars in Lisbon".

name: search_lists
title: Search live lists
